query: What visit-note signals suggest high urgency?

per_column.name: acute_symptom_timeline
per_column.rationale: Symptom onset timing is a genuine, well-motivated axis for urgency analysis. Samples are soundly read: 'x3 days'->three_plus_days, 'yesterday'->hours_to_one_day, and silent rows correctly 'not_specified'. Heavily dominated by not_specified (188) which limits leverage somewhat but does not undermine groundedness.

per_column.name: urgent_diagnostic_or_intervention_trigger
per_column.rationale: Concept is highly relevant to urgency. However groundedness is weak in samples: a routine annual physical with lipid/HbA1c ordered is tagged 'lab_findings_critical' (no critical findings stated), and topical acne treatment is tagged 'procedural_intervention_same_visit' with no procedure in text. The knee MRI->imaging_ordered_urgently is well grounded, but multiple confident overstatements pull the score down.

per_column.name: treatment_intensity_or_escalation
per_column.rationale: Escalation intensity is a strong urgency proxy and a good grouping axis. Most samples are reasonable (routine follow-ups->routine, adapalene/doxycycline->medication change). But the knee case labeled 'multiple_specialist_consults_acute' is unsupported—only a single ortho MRI order is described, no multiple consults.

per_column.name: department_disposition
per_column.rationale: Largely a restatement of the existing 'department' column with an acuity tag appended, so limited new analytical leverage. The acuity tags are also sometimes wrong: a routine post-MI stable follow-up is tagged 'cardiology_with_acute_issue' and a mild viral URI 'pediatrics_with_concern', contradicting the benign source text.

judge.rationale: The added columns target urgency-relevant axes (symptom timeline, diagnostic triggers, treatment escalation) that give real grouping/modeling leverage, though department_disposition largely duplicates an existing column. Groundedness is uneven: acute_symptom_timeline reads the text well, but the trigger, escalation, and disposition columns show several confident overstatements not supported by the source text (critical labs and procedures on routine visits, 'acute'/'with concern' tags on explicitly benign cases), indicating a tendency to over-assert urgency.
